GTM ENABLEMENT MANAGER



Procurify is the leading agentic procurement platform for the mid-market, helping organizations take control of their spend and make smarter financial decisions.

 

We’re building an ambitious, high-performance company where talented people are trusted with meaningful ownership and given the opportunity to make a real impact. Our remote-first culture values accountability, resilience, collaboration, and continuous growth. You’ll work alongside driven teammates on complex, important problems, grow your career through meaningful challenges, and help shape an AI-native company at a defining moment in the evolution of agentic procurement. We’re looking for a talented and team-driven GTM Enablement Manager to join us on our journey.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a GTM Enablement Manager, you will architect the systems, workflows, and intelligence that drive the performance and effectiveness of all GTM teams — including Sales, Customer Experience (CX), and Partnerships. Rather than treating enablement as a series of one-off trainings, you'll approach it as an interconnected system: designing onboarding programs, coaching frameworks, and playbooks that reinforce one another and compound in value over time.



We're looking for someone who thinks from first principles — questioning why processes exist, breaking problems down to their fundamentals, and rebuilding them in ways that are simpler, faster, and more scalable. A core focus of this role is reimagining how GTM teams manage, qualify, and convert inbound opportunities into real pipeline, while elevating outbound execution, customer engagement, and partner-facing motions through automation and AI.



This role sits at the intersection of enablement and our evolution as an AI-enhanced platform. You'll champion how AI and automation can eliminate manual work, surface better insights, and help both our teams and our customers operate more effectively using data. If you see systems where others see silos, and you believe the best process is often the one you can automate away, you'll thrive here.




WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON:

GTM Enablement, Systems & Coaching

 - Design onboarding and ramp programs as repeatable, scalable systems for new GTM hires across Sales, CX, and Partnerships.

 - Develop and deliver ongoing training, coaching, and skills development — increasingly augmented by AI-driven feedback, call intelligence, and automated coaching workflows.

 - Build and maintain playbooks, talk tracks, objection-handling guides, persona briefs, and situational frameworks as living, interconnected assets aligned to our multi-team GTM strategy.

 - Conduct call reviews, coaching sessions, and performance retros — leveraging AI conversation-intelligence tools to scale insights across GTM roles, from inbound qualification to customer success conversations and partner engagements.

Pipeline Support & Opportunity Management (Systems & Automation)

 - Partner with Growth, Marketing, Customer Success, and RevOps to build automated, intelligent systems for lead routing, opportunity management, and renewal orchestration that serve all relevant GTM teams across the full customer lifecycle.

 - Apply first-principles thinking to identify and remove friction in how GTM teams manage pipeline and drive renewals — from initial qualification through expansion and retention — automating the repeatable and reserving human effort for high-value deals and at-risk accounts.

 - Monitor pipeline health and renewal performance as a connected system (e.g., speed-to-lead, pipeline velocity, win rates, renewal rates, net revenue retention, churn risk indicators), using data and automation to drive proactive intervention and training priorities across the GTM org.

Collaboration & Cross-System Alignment

 - Partner with Marketing, RevOps, Product Marketing, Sales Leadership, CX Leadership, and Partnerships Leadership to align messaging, campaigns, processes, and readiness across the entire GTM system.

 - Ensure consistent, automated communication of product updates, market changes, and new GTM initiatives to all customer-facing teams.

 - Act as the voice of GTM teams in internal planning, advocating for scalable systems that serve all teams HR, Sales, CX, and Partnerships.


KPIS FOR SUCCESS

 - Reduced ramp time and improved performance across all GTM roles through scalable, systemized enablement.

 - Increased inbound conversion, qualified pipeline creation, and overall GTM execution quality — accelerated by AI and automation.

 - Consistent adoption of enablement systems, playbooks, and tools across GTM functions.

 - High cross-functional alignment and strong operational partnership with Marketing, RevOps, and Product Marketing.

 - Improved pipeline contribution, follow-up discipline, and customer engagement across GTM.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 3+ years in GTM enablement, Sales/CX/Partnerships leadership, or a coaching-focused go-to-market role.

 - A systems thinker who sees how people, processes, tools, and data connect — and who designs for scale rather than one-off fixes.

 - A first-principles problem solver who questions assumptions, deconstructs complex processes, and rebuilds them more efficiently.

 - Genuine enthusiasm for AI and automation — with a track record (or strong interest) in using them to eliminate manual work and amplify team performance.

 - Deep understanding of full-funnel GTM motions across Sales, CX, and Partnerships teams.

 - Proven ability to design and deliver effective onboarding, enablement, and coaching programs for diverse GTM stakeholders.

 - Strong grasp of lead management, customer engagement processes, CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and GTM performance analytics.

 - Excellent communication, facilitation, and cross-functional influence skills.

 - Data-driven mindset with the ability to diagnose performance gaps and prioritize enablement impact.

 - Passion for developing talent, improving systems, and building high-performing GTM teams.

 - Bonus: Experience in high-growth SaaS; familiarity with Gong, Outreach, Salesloft, enablement platforms, AI/automation tools, or partner engagement tools.

For customer-facing roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.




WHY PROCURIFY?

Help us modernize spend management

Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend — transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we're just getting started.

Powered by our $50M Series C funding, we are actively expanding our core offering, launching new payment capabilities, and building an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience for our customers. Read the press release here. With fresh investment, a strong product foundation, and big ambitions in AI and payments, we're entering our next phase of growth. That means a real opportunity to shape what we build, how we scale, and the impact we have on our customers.

The best part? The team. We're a group of builders who move fast, think big, and show up for each other. No egos, no passengers, just people who want to do great work and win together.

If you're looking for a place where you can make a real impact alongside a team that raises the bar, you'll fit right in.



Be empowered to do your best work

We've created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:

 - Flexible working: We're a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada! And US if applicable.

 - Responsible time off: We offer a flexible approach to time off; we trust our team to take the time they need to rest and recharge while staying accountable to their commitments.

 - Extended health benefits: We prioritize our team's health and well-being. We offer a competitive health, vision, and dental package along with an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account.

 - Continuous Learning: We host regular educational lunch and learns to help our team grow, share knowledge, and stay curious.

 - Stock options: Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program.

 - Base Salary Range: $64,000 - $80,000 (This range is dependent on experience and not inclusive of any bonus, commission, benefits or equity that might exist in your total compensation package.)
   
   

Work with an amazing team



We've welcomed team members who were boat captains, funeral directors, swing dancers, competitive gamers, plumbers, and novelists. Everyone has a story and we're here to embrace them!




LEARN MORE



Procurify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any team members or applicants for employment because of race, color, disability, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity and/or expression.

If you feel like you don't meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that feelings of imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and we certainly don't want those feelings to get in the way of meeting you! We really want to get to know you and why you're great for the role. Please avoid including your picture and age on your resume.



Apply online today and let's start a conversation.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

We are looking for a delivery-focused Project Manager to run acquisition migrations end-to-end as Beacon standardizes each newly acquired company onto a common GTM stack. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who runs several projects at once against a hard deadline, keeps a lot of moving parts coordinated, and raises the bar on the quality of work around them.

Beacon acquires roughly one software company per week which is then integrated into our standardized GTM stack. This role partners with newly acquired companies starting from the first discovery call, through CRM and Support Ticketing builds, until systems are fully rolled out. This role coordinates internal resources and ensures the portfolio company is trained on the tech stack while adhering to an SLA and making the process more repeatable with every acquisition.

This role is responsible for running the project, meaning holding the timeline, managing the stakeholders, directing the build resources, and making sure what ships is right. This role will be partnered with a technical RevOps resource to help with deeper technical support, but this role will be responsible for speaking to the toolset at a high-level.





WHAT YOU WOULD OWN:

 - Migration delivery. Acquisition migrations against our SLA, owned end to end: scoping, project planning, sequencing the CRM and Support Ticketing builds, coordinating data migration, and making sure the team is trained and confident at go-live. You would lead discovery calls to assess their current stack and map it to Beacon's standards, hold the plan and the timeline across several concurrent migrations, manage dependencies and risks before they become slips, and own the status.

 - Contractor direction and quality. You would direct the work of pooled implementation contractors assigned to your migrations, pull in technical support when a problem genuinely needs it, make day-to-day scope and sequencing calls within the documented playbook, and escalate only genuine exceptions.

 - Delivery process. Improving the migration playbook as you run against it — tightening the plan, the checklists, and the handoffs so each acquisition goes faster and more predictably than the last.




WHO YOU ARE:

 - You have 3–5 years project or program management, running implementation, migration or change management projects — ideally in B2B SaaS, professional services, or consulting. You ideally have managed multiple projects concurrently against firm deadlines..

 - You are literate in Go-To-Market systems. You understand how a CRM and a support platform are put together and can scope a build, and hold a credible conversation with a founder about their GTM tech stack.

 - You have directed the work of others — contractors, an agency pod, or junior admins — even without formal people management.

 - A confident stakeholder-facing communicator. You’re a people person who can understand hesitant stakeholders and help them feel excited during a period of a lot of change.

 - Strong judgment under ambiguity. You make defensible calls from a playbook instead of escalating everything, and you know which exceptions genuinely warrant escalation.

 - A quality bar you set rather than inherit. You care how the build looks six months after go-live, not just at handoff.

 - Strong written communication. Much of this job is a clear status update landing in the right inbox at the right time

 - A bias for action. You would rather move something forward than perfect the plan

 - The agility to adapt when a program changes shape mid-stream, and the confidence to get hands-on when it needs you




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Formal project management training or certification (PMP or similar).

 - Familiar with project management tools (Asana, JIRA, Monday.com http://Monday.com).

 - Hands-on CRM experience (HubSpot, Salesforce, PipeDrive, Zoho, etc.)

 - Hands-on Support experience (Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, etc.)

 - M&A exposure, particularly post-close systems consolidation.

 - Familiarity with migration tooling or scripting that moves data faster and more reliably than manual imports allow.

About AI Acquisition 
 AI Acquisition is a bootstrapped, multi-entity business helping founders and operators scale with AI. We combine SaaS platforms, consulting, and a full sales and delivery engine. We manage thousands of active clients across multiple products and operate globally.
 The Role 
 You're taking over an existing book of established client relationships. These are not new clients figuring out what they bought. They've been with us, they know the product, and they have expectations built on months of experience with the business.
 Your job is to keep them progressing, keep them retained, and keep them expanding. That means understanding where each client actually is in their business, what's working, what's stuck, and what they need next. Not checking in for the sake of it. Actually moving the needle on their results.
 This is a consulting role disguised as account management. You're not managing a spreadsheet of renewals. You're advising business owners on how to grow: how to frame their offer, how to think about their funnel, how to close deals, how to handle fulfillment, and how to use AI to do all of it faster.
 The clients you inherit will have history, context, and in some cases, frustrations that predate you. Your first job is to audit that book, understand every account's real status, and earn trust through competence rather than promises.
 What You'll Own 
 An established portfolio of legacy clients across various stages of maturity and engagement
 Regular check-ins, growth workshops, and strategic conversations with business owners who are building and scaling real companies
 Client retention — spotting risk before it becomes a refund conversation, re-engaging clients who've gone quiet, and resolving issues without escalation
 Business consulting — advising clients on offer framing, lead generation strategy, sales process, prospecting, closing, and fulfillment. You need to understand these well enough to coach, not just relay information
 Upsell identification — knowing when a client is ready for more and positioning the next step as the natural move, not a sales pitch
 Cross-functional coordination with the onboarding, deliverables, and office hours teams to make sure nothing falls through the cracks
 Documentation — every interaction, decision, and next step logged so anyone picking up your account knows exactly where things stand
 What We Need From You 
 Native or near-native English fluency is non-negotiable. You will be on camera with clients daily and every conversation needs to land with clarity and confidence
 Direct experience as a CSM, account manager, or business consultant where you personally advised clients on how to start, grow, or scale a business. Not just managed the relationship, actually consulted on the business itself
 You understand the mechanics of lead generation, sales funnels, cold email, LinkedIn outreach, and how they connect to a client's revenue. You don't need to execute campaigns yourself but you need to diagnose why one isn't converting and coach the client through it
 You've managed a portfolio of clients where retention and expansion were your responsibility, not someone else's
 You're comfortable with difficult conversations. Clients who are frustrated, clients who are stuck, clients who need honest feedback about their own execution. You handle these with composure and directness
 You come with solutions, not just problems. When something breaks in a client's journey, your instinct is to propose the fix, not report the issue and wait
 You pick things up fast. The biggest challenge for external hires in this role has been the knowledge gap — there is a lot to learn about our products, processes, and client journeys, and you need to absorb it quickly enough to be credible in front of clients within weeks, not months
 You're comfortable with AI tools and either already use them in your work or will learn without being told to
 This Is Not For You If 
 You only know relationship management without the business consulting layer. "Keeping clients happy" is not the job. Moving their business forward is
 You need months to ramp before you can have a real conversation with a client. Our clients won't wait that long
 You're uncomfortable advising business owners on sales, prospecting, or offer strategy. That's a core part of the role, not a nice-to-have
 You avoid hard conversations or tell clients what they want to hear instead of what they need to hear
 You wait to be told what's wrong rather than finding it yourself
 What Success Looks Like 
 Your clients are progressing, not just retained. Business results, not just satisfaction scores
 Clients at risk are flagged and handled before they escalate. You're the person who prevents the refund conversation, not the one having it
 You've audited your book within the first two weeks and can articulate every client's real status, not what's in the notes
 You're coaching clients on their business, not just updating them on deliverables
 You pick up the product knowledge fast enough to be credible in front of clients by week three
 You adopt new tools and processes without being chased
 The Environment 
 This is a high-performance, remote-first team at the cutting edge of AI-powered business building.
 Direct access to department heads from day one
 Strong performers progress quickly based on what they deliver, not tenure
 Exposure to AI-led systems and tools daily
 Autonomy and ownership over your portfolio
 A team that holds a high bar and expects the same from everyone
 This role operates as an independent contractor engagement: invoice-based, permanent structure, regulated notice periods on both sides. We expect 50 to 60 hours a week from our best people, not as a crunch but as the natural shape of work that matters.
 If you're looking for structure handed to you, this isn't the right place. If you want to be the one "Lifting the Hood", build something real, and raise the bar every week with a team that moves fast, we want to talk.

 Ask every happy client for referrals, and follow up until they turn into conversations

 Spot clients drifting away and get on the phone before they leave
 Log every call and next step in HubSpot, and own your weekly numbers: contacts, opportunities, referrals, cases

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 About Okta Secures AI Team 
 The Okta Secures AI Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure. 
 Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.
 We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agentic Identity—including pioneer work with securing AI Agents and support for protocols like MCP. You will be helping us build the infrastructure that allows enterprises to scale AI safely, ensuring every access decision—whether made by a human or an automated agent—is authenticated, authorized, and audited at scale.
 We are a diverse team of engineers, product managers, and designers who are bringing Okta’s expertise in identity to define the future of Agent Identity management, focusing on enablement while staying secure.

Operating under the larger Okta Secures AI group, the Agent Access Policies team owns Agent Access Policies and enables least-privilege agentic access to enterprise resources, giving administrators per-agent control over which tools an agent may call and which employees it may act for.

A core responsibility of this role is delivering strategic guidance to ensure best-in-class asset performance while proactively meeting escalating customer expectations for reliability, electrification, and grid safety.  Lead, mentor and manage a team of supervisors and engineers, establishing technical governance, setting departmental goals, optimizing workload distribution, and conducting performance reviews to drive a safe, high-performing engineering culture.

 Navigate complex regulatory compliance frameworks, industry standards, safety codes, and provincial and municipal mandates, providing the technical justification and risk modeling required for the Distribution System Plan and Ontario Energy Board Rate Applications.
 Develop, defend, and strategically manage the department’s annual operational and maintenance and capital expenditure budgets, optimizing resource allocation across standards development, protection coordination, and asset management.
 Direct the application of advanced asset health indexing, lifecycle costing algorithms, and root-cause failure investigations to predict equipment risks and inform data-driven capital replacement.
 Oversee the scoping and scoring of System Renewal capital projects, utilizing the corporate Value Framework to prioritize capital allocation toward the highest-risk assets.
 Anticipate the long-term impacts of electrification, climate change, and distributed energy resource integration on distribution assets, steering the team toward forward-thinking engineering standards and practices.

 Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an accredited university 
 Professional Engineer licensed in the Province of Ontario

 Notre réseau de 37 sites de production de médicaments et de vaccins a livré 1,7 milliard d’unités de médicaments et 409 millions de doses de vaccins en 2024, contribuant ainsi à améliorer la santé de millions de personnes.  Nous recherchons les meilleurs talents et les plus grandes expertises pour nous accompagner dans notre parcours vers la fabrication de produits de plus en plus complexes. Ce rôle offre une occasion d’avoir un impact concret sur le terrain, de contribuer à des projets visibles et de développer vos compétences techniques et en leadership, tout en aidant GSK à unir la science, la technologie et les talents pour devancer la maladie, ensemble.

 Maintenir et améliorer les programmes de santé, de sécurité et d’environnement (SSE) du site afin d’assurer leur conformité aux lois canadiennes et québécoises ainsi qu’aux normes de l’entreprise.
 Réaliser des évaluations des risques, des inspections en milieu de travail et des contrôles d’hygiène industrielle. Recommander des mesures correctives et en assurer le suivi.
 Enquêter sur les incidents et les quasi-accidents, en déterminer les causes fondamentales et diriger la mise en œuvre des mesures correctives et préventives.
 Concevoir et offrir des formations et des activités de sensibilisation en SSE, claires et pratiques, destinées aux opérateurs, aux entrepreneurs et aux équipes du site.
 Fournir une expertise SSE dans le cadre des projets, des modifications de procédés et des activités de mise en service afin de garantir la sécurité des conceptions et des transferts opérationnels.

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. ABOUT THE ROLE

Help build the engine behind what traders love



We are hiring a Marketing Operations & Campaign Manager to power our Active Trader business. This is the person who turns strategy into shipped work—the operational backbone who keeps creative projects, compliance reviews, and campaign briefs moving on time and at quality. You don't need to be a trader yourself, but financial literacy and genuine curiosity about markets will help you move fast and speak the same language as the rest of the pod.



You'll be the connective tissue of the Active Trader marketing team. Where our Product Marketing Managers set direction and shape narrative, you make it real: building briefs, running the creative pipeline, managing legal and compliance review, and keeping every campaign coordinated across a busy set of stakeholders. You'll own the systems and rituals that let a small team ship a lot, without dropping details or missing a regulatory requirement.



You'll thrive here if you're energized by getting things organized, love making messy processes simple, and take pride in being the person everyone trusts to have the details covered.




IN THIS ROLE YOU'LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:

 - Own the campaign operating rhythm: Run the end-to-end workflow for Active Trader campaigns, from brief to creative to launch to results analysis so work ships on time, on message, and on budget. Build and maintain the trackers, timelines, and intake process that keep the pod aligned.

 - Write and manage briefs: Turn strategic direction into clear, complete creative and campaign briefs that give designers, copywriters, and partners everything they need. Chase down the open questions before they become delays.

 - Drive creative project management: Coordinate designers, writers, agencies, and cross-functional partners across concurrent projects. Manage scope, feedback loops, versions, and approvals so creative lands polished and on schedule.

 - Own compliance and legal review: Be the point person for getting marketing materials through legal, compliance, and regulatory review (e.g., CIRO requirements). Understand what's required, prep submissions cleanly, track approvals, and build the guardrails that keep us both fast and compliant.

 - Keep stakeholders coordinated: Partner daily with Product Marketing, Growth, Brand, Design, Legal/Compliance, and external vendors—making sure the right people have the right information at the right time.

 - Track and report results: Stand up the reporting and post-mortem process so we know what shipped, what worked, and what to do differently. Keep budgets and timelines honest.

 - Leverage AI to streamline operations: Use AI tools to speed up briefing, drafting, reporting, and project coordination, and to remove friction from repetitive work.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 5+ years of experience: in marketing operations, campaign management, creative/project management, or agency account/traffic management—ideally in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

 - Proven project management chops: You've run multiple concurrent campaigns or creative projects end-to-end and kept them on time, on scope, and on quality.

 - Experience managing compliance or regulatory review: Financial services, healthcare, or other regulated industry experience is a strong plus; you know how to move fast and stay within the lines.

 - Excellent briefing and written communication: You write clear briefs and crisp updates, and you make complex processes feel simple.

 - Financial literacy and curiosity about markets: You don't need to be an active trader, but you're comfortable with financial concepts and eager to learn the trader audience.

 - Sharp attention to detail: You catch the typo, the missing approval, and the date that doesn't line up.

 - Comfort with tools and light data: Familiarity with project management and marketing tools; basic comfort reading a dashboard or a simple dataset (SQL is a nice-to-have).

 - Fluency with AI tools: Experience using AI tools that boost productivity and reduce busywork.

 - Bias toward action and comfort with ambiguity: You make things happen without waiting to be told.

 - Growth mindset and a service orientation: You take pride in making the whole team better and shipping quality work.

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*
